reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Toner 300ml
reviews.text: Using this on my scalp after I wash my hair in the morning and before I apply a rebalancing serum . My scalp health has improved
reviews.zh: 我朝早洗完頭之後、搽平衡精華之前會用喺頭皮。頭皮健康有改善。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Toner 300ml
reviews.text:
First time I'm using a toner, it sooths my skin well after my skincare, and it's lightly hydrating ! It helps with my redness and irritation too !
The only problem is the application (I'm clumsy, so it's quickly messy ^^'), but I just put it in a spray bottel, and it does the trick ! 

(sorry for my english, I'm french ^^')
reviews.zh:
第一次用爽膚水，搽完護膚品之後用佢舒緩皮膚好有效，而且有輕微保濕效果！對泛紅同刺激都有幫助！
唯一問題係用法（我手殘，所以好快就搞到周圍都係 ^^'），不過我裝入噴樽入面用就得掂！

（唔好意思我英文唔好，係法國人 ^^'）

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Toner 300ml
reviews.text: A great toner for dry winter areas. Makes my skin feel much better before the next steps in my skin care routine.
reviews.zh: 適合冬天乾燥天氣用嘅好爽膚水。搽完之後再做接落嘅護膚步驟之前，皮膚感覺好咗好多。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Toner 300ml
reviews.text: He probado varios productos de la marca y ahora le tocó el turno a éste. Deja muy hidratada mi piel la cual es seca y sensible. No me irritó ni nada y tal vez la utilizaría mejor que la de la línea Dokdo, la cual también me gusta, pero no siento que me hidrate tanto como éste.
reviews.zh: 我試過呢個品牌嘅幾款產品，而家終於試到呢款。佢幫我塊面（我係乾性敏感肌）保濕得好勁。完全冇刺激過，可能我會覺得佢比起 Dokdo 系列更加好用，我自己都鍾意嗰個系列，但就冇呢款咁保濕。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Toner 300ml
reviews.text:
Ingredient list is clean for acne-prone skin, but I broke out and my skin felt inflamed and was red. 

Stopped using this product and my skin went back to normal, sad normally I love all of ROUND Labs birch line but this did not agree with my skin
reviews.zh:
成分表對暗瘡肌嚟講算乾淨，但我用完爆咗瘡，皮膚感覺發炎又泛紅。

停用之後皮膚就回復正常，可惜喎，平時我鍾意晒 ROUND Labs 嘅白樺系列，但呢款同我嘅皮膚夾唔到。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Toner 300ml
reviews.text: I bought this product for my brother who struggles with blackheads and hormonal acne. It has helped him get rid of a lot of his acne and blackheads. It is not irritating and gently cleanses/exfoliates his skin. Would recommend!
reviews.zh: 我買呢款畀我阿哥，佢一直受黑頭同荷爾蒙暗瘡困擾。用咗之後幫佢解決咗好多暗瘡同黑頭。唔刺激，而且溫和清潔／去角質佢嘅皮膚。推薦！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Toner 300ml
reviews.text: So hydrating! The texture is like thick water, but not too thick. I apply two layers in the morning/night and it doesn't irritate my skin or eyes, which is great because my old toner made my cheeks and eye area sting a bit.
reviews.zh: 超保濕！質地好似杰咗少少嘅水，但又唔會太杰。朝早或夜晚我會搽兩層，唔刺激皮膚或者眼睛，對我嚟講好重要，因為之前用嘅爽膚水會令面頰同眼周有少許拮。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Toner 300ml
reviews.text:
Great toner. Got this for my boyfriend who has very dry skin, and he seems to be loving it.

His skin was dry to a point where it would get flakey in spots, but this product hasn't irritated his skin more, and seems to be helping. A nice step before his moisturizer. I got all products from ROUND LAB ROUND that incorporated 'moisturizing' in it's name. Skin has improved a lot.
reviews.zh:
好好用嘅爽膚水。買畀男朋友，佢皮膚好乾，而家睇嚟佢好鍾意。

佢之前皮膚乾到局部會甩皮，但呢款產品冇令佢皮膚更加刺激，而且似乎有幫助。係搽保濕霜之前嘅一個好步驟。我買齊咗 ROUND LAB ROUND 所有名稱入面有 'moisturizing' 嘅產品。皮膚改善咗好多。
